text.title: The Weights in the Walls
text.production_notes: Deep sub-bass hum + distant drones; high-pitched glitch clicks; minimal pulse early (no full drums); gradual warm pads & analog swells; subtle sidechain movement; stereo expands mono→wide; organic textures (tape/air) fade in; final bloom of shimmering synth layers; glitches resolve musically; outro fades into harmonic noise
text.vocal_notes: Androgynous, intimate, slightly synthetic; half-whispered with granular glitches; off-grid phrasing; layered harmonies build over time; light vocoder/reverse effects; emotion shifts from detached → overwhelmed → soft wonder
section_names: Intro – sub-bass hum | distant glitch ticks | barely audible voice fragments
Verse 1 – sparse glitch pulses | cold, minimal
Hook – airy but restrained | faint harmonic pad enters
Verse 2 – rhythm emerges from clicks | slightly more forward
Hook – fuller | low pulse + widening stereo
Bridge – instrumental glitch wash → sudden drop | whispered, intimate
Turn – warmth enters | soft analog pad bloom | subtle rhythm
Verse 3 – melodic phrasing emerges | more human tone
Hook – expansive | shimmering layers | harmonic lift toward F major
Final Section – full bloom | warm, immersive, wide
Outro – fading synths | residual glitch becomes soft texture
